# Skill Olympus

> A skill library that lets Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and Grok share the same workflow — a harness-engineering and loop-engineering stack, named after the Twelve Olympians. 100 skills, 42 agents, shared across 4 CLIs.

Zeus is the harness layer: one non-interactive request is kept alive, decomposed, implemented, inspected, deployed, tested, and reported without handing "next steps" back to the user. Chronos is the loop layer on top of that harness — a verification gate that runs real tests, paired with Minos (fix-until-pass), Argos (AC cross-check), and Clio (GO/NO-GO). Since v4.7.0 these loops run on CLI-native features, including the `/goal` stop gate.

Grok Build (xAI's CLI) is supported with zero sync since v4.15.0: its Claude-compat layer reads the installed `~/.claude/` skills, agents, MCP servers, and rules directly, and the grok-mnemo adapter adds cross-session conversation memory (auto-saving turns to the shared per-project `conversations/` log that all four CLIs search).

Since v4.20.0, Themis (Titaness of law) audits a codebase for every personal-data collection, storage, outbound-transfer, and deletion point with file:line evidence, interviews the operator for what code cannot tell (retention, privacy officer, children, server region), and generates per-country privacy-policy drafts (Korean PIPA Art. 30 / US CCPA-CPRA / EU GDPR Art. 13) — unverified items stay explicit blanks, never invented. The same release added recording opt-out: MNEMO_DISABLE stops all conversation/tool-log auto-saving across the 4 CLIs, and OLYMPUS_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLE turns off the session-start version check.
